ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) central region spanning the median notch and inner lobes; high-intensity (white) regions are localized to the distal halves of both lobes with extensive high-frequency mottling at the pigmentation boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a measured internal angle of approximately 140 degrees and a defined central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude (3-12 pixels) serrations along the entire visible trailing edge, showing increased irregularity and peak density at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips; the overall aspect ratio is wide and tapered.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular pixel formations concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular trailing edge topography at the distal tips suggesting historical tissue loss or wear, accompanied by substantial barnacle accumulation.
